title: microlepia marginata var. calvescens
intro: Microlepia marginata var. calvescens, commonly known as Chinese Algae Moss, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Microlepia marginata var. calvescens are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antitumor activity, and provide protection against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
